materials.name: Ventilated reusable crate
materials.benefit: Supports the load while open vents allow airflow.
materials.tradeoff: Needs cleaning, suitable stacking and a practical return route.
materials.seal: No hermetic seal for this bulk-produce use
materials.mechanical: Check stacking load, vent alignment and drop resistance with supplier.
materials.sustainability: Reuse can reduce single-use material when crates are returned and cleaned.

materials.name: Vented corrugated produce box
materials.benefit: Lightweight secondary protection with configurable dividers.
materials.tradeoff: Moisture and stacking can reduce performance; test the actual route.
materials.mechanical: Specify tested compression strength at expected humidity.
materials.sustainability: Check local collection and coatings before calling it recyclable.

materials.name: Breathable produce film
materials.family: Perforated PE or PP film + protective tray
materials.benefit: A candidate route to balance respiration with gas exchange.
materials.tradeoff: Perforation design must be matched to pack geometry and use temperature.
materials.seal: Verify final pack leakage, seals and perforation consistency
materials.mechanical: Check puncture resistance and protect heads from compression.
materials.sustainability: Simpler compatible materials may help sorting; confirm local acceptance.

materials.name: Vented tray or produce bag
materials.benefit: Allows air exchange without deliberately establishing low oxygen.
materials.tradeoff: Moisture loss and handling protection still need assessment.
materials.seal: Vented, not a claimed MAP seal
materials.mechanical: Select a tray or outer crate suitable for transport loads.
materials.sustainability: Consider a reusable outer crate and minimal food-contact material.

materials.name: Metallized barrier pouch
materials.benefit: A candidate structure for light, moisture and oxygen protection.
materials.tradeoff: The substrate sheet does not describe the finished pouch or its seals.
materials.seal: Require a compatible food-contact sealant and validated seal window
materials.mechanical: Check flex cracking, pinholes and transport puncture resistance.
materials.sustainability: Metal coating, adhesives and sealant affect sorting and recycling.

measurements.note: Historical typical substrate value; delta-pressure basis not established here.
Historical substrate value; supplier method/scaling footnotes apply, not automatically comparable to your conditions.

materials.name: Barrier mono-PE candidate
materials.benefit: Explore a simpler material stream with the converter.
materials.tradeoff: Barrier coating, thickness and oxygen performance must be measured.
materials.seal: Ask for the seal-temperature window and contaminated-seal tests
materials.mechanical: Check puncture, stiffness and required outer protection.
materials.sustainability: Potential design-for-recycling benefit only if the full structure and local system support it.

materials.name: Aluminium-foil laminate
materials.family: Foil barrier + structural and sealant layers
materials.benefit: A candidate when a demanding barrier target justifies a complex structure.
materials.tradeoff: Seals and flex-induced pinholes can dominate pack performance.
materials.seal: Require converter validation of the complete food-contact laminate
materials.mechanical: Test flex cracking, puncture and filled-pack drop performance.
materials.sustainability: Multiple bonded materials can complicate recovery; avoid unnecessary overpackaging.
